OT_DECLARED`, unless `--force`), and `events watch` when no delivery mode fits both the event and the profile |\n| `3` | `tasks co
nformance` and `events conformance`: the run was incomplete — applicable checks never ran, so it is neither a pass nor a spec viol
ation |\n| `6` | `tasks watch` only: the task needs input this run could not answer. Answer it with `tasks update`, or re-run with
`--interactive` in a TTY |\n| `7` | `tasks watch` only: `--duration-ms` elapsed before the task reached a terminal status |\n| `1
30` | Interrupted by a signal (`tasks watch` aborted, or a second Ctrl-C during `tunnel` shutdown) |\n\nCodes above `2` are reserv
ed for outcomes a script should act on *differently* — not merely for naming a failure. See [MCP Tasks](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cl

i/tasks.md#watch-exit-codes) for the full `tasks watch` mapping.
